'''''Bothan Beauty''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] created by the legendary [[Artist/Legends|artist]] [[Bahzel]]. It was a particularly well known work, and copies of it were available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The painting depicted a [[brown]]-furred [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] gazing from the left side of the work to the right. Behind her was a background of brown that faded into [[blue]] as it moved from the left to the right. A lighter-hued watermark in the shape of a rounded-off sunburst was superimposed over the image. Overall, the work's style was similar to that of ''[[Bothan Buff]]'', another painting created by Bahzel.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:FemaleBothanConcept.jpg|200px|thumb|Early concept art for a female Bothan, similar to the one used in the painting]]
''Bothan Beauty'' is a painting that appears in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment. It can be used in the player character's personal home as decoration. It was added to the game in the ''Hotfix 17.10'' game update on [[October 7]], [[2010]] as part of the "rare loot system," which allows players to obtain exceedingly rare items as loot from any enemy in the game.<ref name="SWG" />

The artwork for the painting had existed in the game's files for some time before this, however, and was an edited version of the female Bothan concept art for the game.<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref><ref name="Pencil">''[[From Pencil to Pixel: The Art of Star Wars Galaxies]]''</ref>
